title: Sound on
body:
Sound on for this one. Another look at Odd Spark: catching sugar cubes, tipping the cup, and spilling coffee. Still a work in progress.

[video: Odd Spark gameplay with sound: catching sugar cubes while coffee spills from the cup.](../media/odd-spark-2026-09-27-sound-on/sound_on_spark_compat.mp4)
